title: Identity-Locked Narrative Portrait Sequence
description: A nine-image identity-locked portrait series for Noir Character Poster Portraits, built from one reference portrait and eight dependent variations.
creative_direction: Portrait backlog lock: image 01 establishes the exact person for Noir Character Poster Portraits; images 02-09 all depend on that reference and may vary only lighting, scene, wardrobe, pose, emotion, or grooming while preserving the same face, hair base, and body proportions.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-character-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-interior-scene, 03-transition-pause, 04-closeup-emotion, 05-exterior-walk, 06-profile-shadow, 07-detail-prop-frame, 08-poster-crop, 09-finale-aftermath. Queue may run 02-09 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
